6.189 rwWrongNumberOfDataCellsInDataRow
rwWrongNumberOfDataCellsInDataRow is a critical error that will occur if a
CustomReportItem.CustomData element contains a different number of DataRow.DataCell elements
within a DataRows collection than the number of leaf-node DataGrouping elements within the
DataColumnGroupings collection. (A leaf-node DataGrouping element does not contain a child
DataGrouping.DataGroupings element.)
